//: echojs-vs-node divergences the ejs lane FOUND and root-caused (2026-07-23,
echojs eir work tree, stage0 node-hosted compiler). Each is a pre-existing
echojs runtime/compiler bug, verified by minimal standalone probes — not a
maam machine bug (the concrete-vs-node lane is green on every one of these
files). They are recorded here so the lane stays honest: a listed file that
STOPS diverging fails the gate as stale (remove it when echojs is fixed),
and any divergence NOT listed fails the gate outright. Tracked in echojs
arith-coercion.js: echojs runtime aborts on `1 + null`: ejsval ToNumber(ejsval) at runtime/ejs-ops.c:260 'not implemented' (exit 134). JS: null coerces to 0.
arith-intops.js: `-8 >>> 28` is 0 under echojs, 15 under node — ToUint32 on a negative shift operand is wrong/unimplemented.
arith-negzero.js: `-0 === 0` is false under echojs (NaN-boxed bit comparison; JS strict equality must treat the zeros as equal). 1/-0 = -Infinity is correct, so it is the comparison, not -0 production.
compare-numbers.js: same root cause as arith-negzero.js: `-0 === 0` strict-equality bug.
math-statics.js: `Math.round(-2.5)` is -3 under echojs (C round(): half away from zero), -2 under JS (half toward +Infinity).
strings-number-render.js: `Number("  7  ")` is NaN under echojs — ToNumber(string) does not trim whitespace; JS requires it (7).
typeof-table.js: `typeof null` is "null" under echojs; the spec requires "object".
